notes.title: SPOOKY UPDATE - October 18
notes.notes:
For a special limited-time Halloween promotion, we’re unlocking the Halloween and Boo! worlds right away eliminating your need to earn all the loot items to unlock them. 

Difficulty Warning - not for the faint of heart. Face off against bats and ghosts in 40 spooky Halloween-themed levels. Claim your treats (gems!) without running into tricks (bats and ghosts!) 

As a reminder, all of these ghastly Halloween level elements are also available in the Level Editor if you find yourself in a creative holiday mood. 
 
Other things new in this update:

[list]
[*][b]Added Steam Cloud Save Support[/b] – Record your level progress to the cloud and continue as you left it on any device. Resolution and difficulty settings still remain locally controlled. 
[*][b]Removed Powers-ups in Hardcore mode[/b] – Bringing the game even closer to its classic level of difficulty.
[*][b]Added Flat Cam Option[/b] – We’ve tweaked the camera slightly to make the game look more like its original classic perspective. If you hate it, we also added a toggle in the Options menu to go back to the 3D perspective view!  
[/list]

Thanks! 

Team TapStar
